notes: Rubric derived from the UWP source checklist and the live UWP launch (scenario-1 golden captured). Per-scenario UWP UIA actuation was not possible in this headless session (no interactive input desktop; UWP CoreWindow XAML UIA tree not exposed), so behavioral ground truth is taken from the source handlers.

features.title: Current activity
features.expected: Button reads the default ActivitySensor current reading and fills Activity / Confidence / Timestamp output fields (or a 'no sensor' status when hardware is absent).

features.title: Activity history
features.expected: Button queries activity history over a time range and lists count + per-record Activity/Confidence/Timestamp (or a status message).

features.title: Events
features.expected: ReadingChanged On subscribes to sensor ReadingChanged events and updates Activity/Confidence/Timestamp; Off unsubscribes. Off is disabled until On succeeds (state-gated), and On only succeeds when an activity sensor is present.

features.title: Background activity
features.expected: Register Task registers a background task for activity reports; Unregister Task removes it. Unregister is disabled until a task is registered (state-gated).
